feedback: Near-perfect match across the full spec: all pages, assets, neon palette, pixel typography, Windows 95 chrome, marquees, dashboard density, masonry observations, storm catalogue, member cards, footer badges, and responsive behavior are strongly executed. The latest changes improve the retro GIF/footer cues. Remaining polish is very small: some oversized bitmap headings still wrap awkwardly in narrow tablet/mobile cards, especially archive article titles and a few member/storm headings; reduce heading size or add responsive word-breaking only in those tight panels.
